tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every page starts here; sections sit directly on it, separated by `line` hairlines, not by tinted bands.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised panels: Window bodies, cards on hover, the nav sheet on mobile.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Window title bars, ticker band, input wells, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed / selected fills and tooltips. Only `ink` text sits on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section rules, grid gaps, card dividers. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips). 3:1+ on surface-0 and surface-1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on every surface (12.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: ledes, descriptions, meta, placeholders. Reads on surface-0/1/2 (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-comment
tokens.usage: The `//` voice: section labels, eyebrows, numbering, form hints. Mono only. Reads on surface-0/1/2 (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Fixline lime. Fills and marks: the Fixline motif, highlighter, the mark tile, resolved status dot, cover blocks. On light it is a FILL only (1.15:1 on paper), never text.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Lime as TEXT and links: inline links, 'resolved' labels, the active nav item. 7:1+ on surface-0/1 in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-wash
tokens.usage: Highlighter behind a fixed phrase (Mark, Fix 'after'). Text on it stays `ink`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Lime on Night shift, ink on Paper. One per view.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action` (14.8:1 both themes).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning squiggles and 'warning:' tooltip codes; 'in progress' is NOT warn. Text-safe on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error squiggles, 'open' issues, field errors. Text-safe on surface-0 and surface-1 (4.5:1+); on surface-2 use it for marks only. Always paired with a word or ✕ glyph; differs from `brand` by 3:1+ in lightness in both themes, so open vs resolved never relies on hue.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: 'In progress' status and neutral notices. Text-safe on surface-0/1/2.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element (13:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the issue dialog and the mobile nav sheet.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero only. Steps down to 44px under 720px (see app/globals.css .ed-display-xl).

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Don't ship the demo as the product.
styles.usage: Case-study hero, closing CTA. 38px on mobile.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Service titles, product names, dialog titles.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card titles, decision titles, list headers.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: You vibe-coded something real. I make it production-ready.
styles.usage: Hero ledes and section intros, max 34em wide. 18px on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Auth, RLS, secrets, API routes. Stop treating 'it works in the demo' as a security model.
styles.usage: Default paragraph text, card descriptions. Never below 16px on mobile.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Section labels, eyebrows, button labels, chips. Uppercase. 12px is the floor: nothing on the site is set smaller.

styles.name: mono-body
styles.usage: Window titles, spec lists, form labels, URLs, code-ish values.

styles.name: mono-comment
styles.usage: Asides in the developer voice: availability, hints, captions. Colour `ink-comment`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, chip inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: label to field, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list item gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), Window body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between a section label and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top padding on desktop (clears the fixed nav).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Sections, Windows, cards, buttons: the system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tooltips, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The mark tile and screenshot frames only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Ask prompt bar, its send button, status pills.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: dialog, tooltip, mobile nav sheet. Nothing resting on the page casts a shadow.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Content max width; the two vertical page rules sit on its edges.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body-l and body paragraphs.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Fixed nav height (56px under 720px).
